page_title: FIO 5-1 UDI | Fiorentina v Udinese 21/12/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+4' The match has just finished.
90+2' Maurizio Mariani blows his whistle. Nicolo Bertola (Udinese) commits a foul after dangerous play. Fiorentina have a free kick.
90' We will have 3 min. of added time.
87' Udinese exchange some short passes over a small area and control the game. Now they make a mistake and lose the ball and the whole situation changes completely.
85' Hans Nicolussi Caviglia (Fiorentina) takes out his opponent with a nasty challenge and is relieved when the referee only gives him a booking.
84' 1:4 – the corner kicks stats.
82' Paolo Vanoli has decided to make a change. Hans Nicolussi Caviglia (Fiorentina) replaces Nicolo Fagioli.
82' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Mattia Viti (Fiorentina) comes onto the pitch so that Pietro Comuzzo can be given a rest.
81' Chance! Albert Gudmundsson (Fiorentina) was in a good position inside the box, but he couldn't connect with the pass as it was overhit.
79' A pass by Idrissa Gueye (Udinese) ends up in no man's land, and the attacking effort comes to an end.
78' Maurizio Mariani interrupts the game. One of the players from Fiorentina won the ball, but his effort is adjudged unfair.
76' A quickly taken corner by Fiorentina.

76' What a great touch by Albert Gudmundsson (Fiorentina) as he controls a fine pass into the box and takes a shot to the bottom left corner, but an opposing player makes a clearance. Great defending. Now Fiorentina have a corner.
75' Fiorentina keep the ball and are displaying some tiki-taka style passing at the moment.
73' 6:3 – this is the current number of shots on target.
71' Paolo Vanoli decides to make a substitution. Moise Kean will be replaced by Roberto Piccoli (Fiorentina).
71' Substitution. Fabiano Parisi did his best and is replaced by Christian Kouame (Fiorentina).
69' 5 - 1 Spectacular goal! Moise Kean (Fiorentina) brilliantly darts into the box to latch on to a cross and buries the ball into the bottom right corner, leaving the goalkeeper stunned!
68' Nicolo Bertola (Udinese) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.

66' 4 - 1 Goal! That was a fantastic finish by Oumar Solet (Udinese) from just outside the box. He wasted little time in getting away a bullet of a shot that flew past the goalkeeper into the top right corner of the net.
66' Kosta Runjaic has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Idrissa Gueye (Udinese) replacing Jurgen Ekkelenkamp.
65' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Adam Buksa (Udinese) comes onto the pitch for Keinan Davis.
65' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Luca Ranieri (Fiorentina) was quite harsh and Maurizio Mariani didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
63' Good team movement sets up Moise Kean (Fiorentina) on the edge of the box, but he slices the ball narrowly wide of the right post.
62' Fiorentina keep possession of the ball by producing short passes and one-two passes from player to player.
60' Dodo (Fiorentina) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender.
58' Here's the current ball possession statistics for both teams – 58:42.
56' 4 - 0 Goal 4:0! Moise Kean (Fiorentina) taps home from close range after the rebound fell kindly into his path.
56' Fabiano Parisi (Fiorentina) creates a good chance for himself and fires in a powerful close-range shot, but his effort ricochets off the right post.
54' Oumar Solet (Udinese) is challenged in the air near the penalty spot and is unable to control his header from the corner, sending it miles over the bar.
54' The referee blows his whistle, Udinese are awarded a corner kick.
53' Rolando Mandragora is substituted due to injury. Paolo Vanoli gives a chance to Niccolo Fortini (Fiorentina).
52' Rolando Mandragora (Fiorentina) is writhing in pain and can now receive medical treatment after the referee signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
50' Oumar Solet (Udinese) is knocked off balance by a defender near the penalty spot and sends his header from the corner well wide of the right post.
49' Udinese earn a corner.

49' Hassane Kamara (Udinese) receives a diagonal pass, bursts into the box and shoots towards the left side of the goal. David de Gea is well positioned, though, and it's a comfortable save. The referee points to the corner flag and Udinese will take a corner.
48' Sandi Lovric (Udinese) goes over to take a corner kick after one of the defenders makes a good clearance.
46' The game is over for Alessandro Zanoli (Udinese). Hassane Kamara comes on for the second half.
46' There will be a change on the pitch for the second half. Kosta Runjaic probably wasn't satisfied with the performance of Nicolo Zaniolo (Udinese). He is replaced by Sandi Lovric.
46' Maurizio Mariani blows his whistle and the second half starts.
45+7' The referee blows his whistle to end the first half and the players are now heading to their respective dressing rooms.

45+5' 3 - 0 Cher Ndour (Fiorentina) scores from quite a difficult position as he leaps high to connect with a cross and powers his header into the middle of the goal. Excellent finish, which the keeper got nowhere near.
45+4' Udinese are showcasing great team work by exchanging some short passes and one-two passes, waiting to open the opposition's defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
45+2' Nicolo Fagioli (Fiorentina) wastes a big chance! He unleashes a shot from the edge of the box and it goes narrowly over the crossbar.
45' There will be a minimum of 5 min. of added time.
44' Udinese players are exchanging short passes with one another, waiting for the right moment to beat the opposition's defence.
42' 2 - 0 Albert Gudmundsson (Fiorentina) takes a great first touch to control a killer pass on the edge of the box and curls the ball into the top right corner in trademark fashion.
40' Fabiano Parisi (Fiorentina) makes a bad challenge on his opponent and is booked by the referee.
39' Alessandro Zanoli (Udinese) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Maurizio Mariani had an easy-decision to make.
37' The current number of fouls conceded by both teams is 1:3.
35' Pietro Comuzzo (Fiorentina) is having a really tough time right now. We are about to find out how serious his injury is.
34' Keinan Davis (Udinese) is asking for medical treatment after picking up an injury.
33' A cross from the by-line finds Keinan Davis (Udinese) unmarked on the penalty spot, but he is unable to find the target and sends his header well wide of the left post.
31' Moise Kean (Fiorentina) takes a mid-range shot, but the ball sails high over the bar.
30' Udinese are bossing possession of the ball and make numerous short passes, but they finally lose possession after an error.
28' Rolando Mandragora (Fiorentina) latches on to a precise pass on the edge of the box, but miskicks his shot and the ball goes high over the bar. Poor effort!
27' The ball is cleared after Fabiano Parisi (Fiorentina) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
25' Jurgen Ekkelenkamp (Udinese) takes the corner but it's cleared.
23' The total number of attempts is 7:2.
21' 1 - 0 Rolando Mandragora (Fiorentina) finds some space just outside the penalty area after getting on the end of a sweet pass and blasts the ball into the goal!
20' Albert Gudmundsson (Fiorentina) controls a pass, goes past a defender and curls a shot from the edge of the box right onto the right post.
18' Fiorentina are dominating the game at the moment by exchanging a combination of one or two touch passes. Great harmony between the players.
16' The ratio of the ball possession is 55:45.
14' Dodo (Fiorentina) attempts to find the head of one of his teammates with a promising cross into the box, but a defender outjumps the attackers and averts the threat.

12' Rolando Mandragora (Fiorentina) attempts to threaten the goalkeeper from the free kick on the edge of the box. He produces a stunning blast which only flies inches over the crossbar. It could have been a beautiful goal!
10' Substitution. Christian Kabasele makes way for Razvan Sava (Udinese).
10' Moise Kean (Fiorentina) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
8' Maduka Okoye (Udinese) makes an awful challenge on his opponent and the referee shows him a deserved red card!
6' Keinan Davis (Udinese) manages to dispossess his opponent of the ball, but he commits a foul in the process and the referee blows his whistle.
5' Fabiano Parisi (Fiorentina) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away.
3' Jakub Piotrowski (Udinese) makes a strong challenge and Maurizio Mariani blows for a foul.
1' Here we go, today's match is starting right now.
The players are out and the match is about to start. Udinese will have the kick-off.
Today's referee will be Maurizio Mariani.
